include(ExternalProject)

set(QT_INSTALL_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/Qt)
set(QT_BASE_SOURCE_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/qtbase)
set(QT_BASE_BINARY_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/qtbase)
set(QT_SVG_SOURCE_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/qtsvg)
set(QT_SVG_BINARY_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/qtsvg)

file(MAKE_DIRECTORY ${QT_INSTALL_DIR})

find_program(CCACHE_BIN NAMES ccache sccache)
if(${CCACHE_BIN} IN_LIST CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER)
    set(QT_USE_CCACHE ON)
else()
    set(QT_USE_CCACHE OFF)
endif()

set(CROSS_COMPILE_ARG
  -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=${CMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE}
  -DARCH=${CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR}
  -DCMAKE_SYSROOT=${CMAKE_SYSROOT}
  -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS=${CMAKE_C_FLAGS}
  -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=${CMAKE_C_COMPILER}
  -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS=${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS}
  -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER}
  -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS=${CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS}
  -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=${QT_INSTALL_DIR}
)

# Ninja is used as the generator since Qt officially supports it best, and Visual Studio 18 2026 currently doesn't work.
set(QT_CONFIG_ARG
  -GNinja
  -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF
  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
  -DQT_USE_CCACHE=${QT_USE_CCACHE}
  -DQT_BUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF
  -DQT_BUILD_BENCHMARKS=OFF
  -DQT_BUILD_TESTS=OFF
  -DQT_INSTALL_EXAMPLES_SOURCES=OFF
  -Wno-dev
  --log-level=STATUS
)

set(QT_BASE_SHARED_CONFIG_ARG
  -DFEATURE_network=OFF
  -DFEATURE_printsupport=OFF
  -DFEATURE_sql=OFF
  -DFEATURE_vulkan=OFF
  -DFEATURE_testlib=OFF
  -DFEATURE_xml=OFF
  -DFEATURE_concurrent=OFF
  -DFEATURE_windeployqt=OFF
  -DFEATURE_androiddeployqt=OFF
  -DFEATURE_qmake=OFF
  -DFEATURE_cxx20=ON
)

if(UNIX AND NOT APPLE)
  list(APPEND QT_BASE_SHARED_CONFIG_ARG
    -DFEATURE_dbus=ON
  )
  list(APPEND QT_EXTRA_MODULES DBus)
else()
  list(APPEND QT_BASE_SHARED_CONFIG_ARG
    -DFEATURE_dbus=OFF
  )
endif()

set(QT_MODULE_CONFIG_ARG
  -DQt6_DIR=${QT_INSTALL_DIR}/lib/cmake/Qt6
)

set(QT_BASE_CONFIG_ARG
  ${QT_CONFIG_ARG}
  ${QT_BASE_SHARED_CONFIG_ARG}
  ${CROSS_COMPILE_ARG}
  -DFEATURE_gui=ON
  -DFEATURE_widgets=ON
  -DFEATURE_opengl=OFF
  -DINPUT_opengl=no
)

find_package(XCB QUIET)
if(XCB_FOUND)
  list(APPEND QT_BASE_CONFIG_ARG -DFEATURE_xcb=ON)
endif()

find_package(Wayland QUIET)
if(Wayland_FOUND)
  list(APPEND QT_BASE_CONFIG_ARG -DFEATURE_wayland=ON)
endif()

if(LINUX)
  list(APPEND QT_BASE_CONFIG_ARG -DFEATURE_linuxfb=ON)
endif()

set(QT_SVG_CONFIG_ARG
  ${QT_CONFIG_ARG}
  ${QT_MODULE_CONFIG_ARG}
  ${CROSS_COMPILE_ARG}
)

set(QT_MODULES BASE SVG)

if(CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING)
  if(NOT QT_HOST_PATH AND NOT QT_HOST_PATH_CMAKE_DIR)
    # TODO: Make this work
    set(QT_HOST_INSTALL_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/QtHost)
    set(QT_HOST_SOURCE_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/qtbase)
    set(QT_HOST_BINARY_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/qthost)
    file(MAKE_DIRECTORY ${QT_HOST_INSTALL_DIR})

    list(APPEND QT_BASE_CONFIG_ARG -DQT_HOST_PATH=${QT_HOST_INSTALL_DIR})
    list(APPEND QT_MODULE_CONFIG_ARG -DQT_HOST_PATH=${QT_HOST_INSTALL_DIR})
    set(QT_HOST_CONFIG_ARG
      ${QT_CONFIG_ARG}
      ${QT_BASE_SHARED_CONFIG_ARG}
      -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=${QT_HOST_INSTALL_DIR}
      -DFEATURE_gui=ON
      -DFEATURE_widgets=ON
      -DFEATURE_opengl=OFF
      -DINPUT_opengl=no
    )
    list(PREPEND QT_MODULES HOST)
    set(QT_HOST_PATH "${QT_HOST_INSTALL_DIR}")
  else()
    list(APPEND QT_BASE_CONFIG_ARG -DQT_HOST_PATH=${QT_HOST_PATH} -DQT_HOST_PATH_CMAKE_DIR=${QT_HOST_PATH_CMAKE_DIR})
    list(APPEND QT_MODULE_CONFIG_ARG -DQT_HOST_PATH=${QT_HOST_PATH} -DQT_HOST_PATH_CMAKE_DIR=${QT_HOST_PATH_CMAKE_DIR})
  endif()
endif()

foreach(MODULE ${QT_MODULES})
    set(QT_MODULE_SOURCE_DIR ${QT_${MODULE}_SOURCE_DIR})
    set(QT_MODULE_BINARY_DIR ${QT_${MODULE}_BINARY_DIR})
    set(QT_MODULE_CONFIG_ARG ${QT_${MODULE}_CONFIG_ARG})

    file(MAKE_DIRECTORY ${QT_MODULE_BINARY_DIR})

    execute_process(
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -DCMAKE_INSTALL_MESSAGE=LAZY ${QT_MODULE_CONFIG_ARG} ${QT_MODULE_SOURCE_DIR}
        WORKING_DIRECTORY ${QT_MODULE_BINARY_DIR}
        COMMAND_ERROR_IS_FATAL ANY
    )

    execute_process(
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} --build ${QT_MODULE_BINARY_DIR} --parallel ${CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL}
        WORKING_DIRECTORY ${QT_MODULE_BINARY_DIR}
        COMMAND_ERROR_IS_FATAL ANY
    )

    execute_process(
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} --install ${QT_MODULE_BINARY_DIR}
        WORKING_DIRECTORY ${QT_MODULE_BINARY_DIR}
        COMMAND_ERROR_IS_FATAL ANY
    )
endforeach()

find_package(Qt6 REQUIRED
  COMPONENTS
    Core
    Widgets
    Gui
    Svg
    ${QT_EXTRA_MODULES}
  PATHS
    ${QT_INSTALL_DIR}
)

set_property(TARGET
    Qt6::Core
    Qt6::Widgets
    Qt6::Gui
    Qt6::Svg
    PROPERTY IMPORTED_GLOBAL TRUE
)

foreach(MODULE ${QT_EXTRA_MODULES})
  set_property(TARGET Qt6::${MODULE} PROPERTY IMPORTED_GLOBAL TRUE)
endforeach()
